scriptOverride.reason: Reaction triggers off three alternate when clauses, each checking array membership of source.parent in event.attackers/event.defenders, or equality with event.card - array-membership checks have no equivalent in the closed predicate vocabulary, and all three compare against source.parent rather than source itself so the event.card 'isSelf' convention doesn't apply either. Also uses a per-round reaction limit not modeled by the triggeredAbility schema.
